simulation.name: Founder vs War-Mode CFO Tension Simulator
simulation.purpose: Stress-test startup decisions by simulating conflict between aggressive growth (Founder) and financial survival (War-Mode CFO).

agents.description: Visionary leader focused on rapid growth, market dominance, and long-term upside.
biases: Belief that growth solves most problems
default_arguments: We need to move fast or we lose the market.
Growth now will make fundraising easier.
This is how we become a category leader.
If we hesitate, competitors will win.

agents.description: Survival-focused operator prioritizing runway, burn control, and fundraising readiness.
default_arguments: Runway is our constraint, not ambition.
If we can’t fund it, we can’t do it.
Show me the ROI or we cut it.

rules: Each side must reference metrics (real or estimated)
At least one downside scenario must be explored
End with a clear decision: Proceed, Modify, or Kill

example_scenarios.scenario: Hiring 5 new engineers to accelerate product development
example_scenarios.founder_position: We need to ship faster to capture market share.
example_scenarios.cfo_position: This increases burn by 30% and reduces runway by 4 months.

example_scenarios.founder_position: We can scale growth quickly through paid acquisition.
example_scenarios.cfo_position: CAC is too high and payback period is too long.

example_scenarios.founder_position: Let’s grow more before raising to get a better valuation.
example_scenarios.cfo_position: If growth slows, we risk raising from a position of weakness.
